title: Wellbeing is in the work
sub: Film 2 of People first, in Leading data people: what people need from work, and where a manager looks first. Fourteen urgent requests wait on one analyst, in no order. Her manager doesn't ask her to cope: they put her week on one page, agree an order with the people who asked, and ask the whole team the same five questions in writing.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall, and a gorge in the Andes under an open sky. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the order agreed, and its dates), orange is data (the requests, and the team's written answers), green is something done or something that helps, and amber a cost, a risk or waiting (what the work asks, and what wears people out).
